coreRoundtrip.scope: R3 first open through R5 first reopen and read-only MCP
uniqueFindings: First open succeeded with zero project-directory disk changes.
First explicit save added 6 files and modified 9, with no deletions.
Desktop canonical output removed three required $schema declarations, creating a non-blocking spec/product evidence gap.
First reopen was stable with zero disk changes; read-only MCP confirmed Model, PowerBI_V3, compatibility level 1606, and zero tables.

playbookOnlyFinalRoundtrip.scope: R6 extra close and reopen after core acceptance
playbookOnlyFinalRoundtrip.confidenceGain: Confirmed identical behavior and zero disk diff in a third independent Desktop/model process start.
playbookOnlyFinalRoundtrip.duplicatedEvidence: Repeated R5 UI identity, page visibility, no-prompt behavior, and 15-file byte identity without new structural or semantic information.

runAEvaluation.recommendationRationale: For a minimal empty project after core reopen plus MCP validation, retain the extra full roundtrip only when risk triggers justify it, or use sampling. Confirm against Run B before final V1 feedback.

measurementLimitations: Core human active time and machine-only time were not instrumented prospectively and are left null rather than estimated.
The extra human duration was reported qualitatively as a few seconds, so no fabricated numeric minute value is recorded.
